Official label (English translation): Mother's race/skin color: 1 White (branca); 2 Black (preta); 3 Asian (amarela); 4 Brown (parda); 5 Indigenous (indígena)
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Tipo de raça e cor da mãe: 1– Branca; 2– Preta; 3– Amarela; 4– Parda; 5– Indígena.
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 → White (reference); 4 → Brown; 2 → Black; 5 → Indigenous. Excluded at step 1 of the exclusion cascade: code 3, missing, and any code outside {1, 2, 4, 5}. Multiple imputation (sensitivity): missing values imputed over codes 1–5 by multinomial logistic regression; births imputed as code 3 excluded.

Official label (English translation): Number of weeks of gestation
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Número de semanas de gestação.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Completed weeks. Inclusion: 22–44 (missing or outside the range excluded). Preterm birth: <37. SGA: eligible 24–42 (gestational age in days = 7×weeks + 3; +0 and +6 in sensitivity analyses). Weight >P97 reclassification: singleton preterm births 24–36. Low birth weight at term: 37–41.
Use: Exclusion; outcome (preterm birth); SGA eligibility; sensitivity

Official label (English translation): Method used [to estimate gestational age]: 1 physical exam; 2 other method; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Método utilizado. Valores: 1– Exame físico; 2– Outro método; 9– Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: 8 (not in the data dictionary) → last menstrual period (LMP); 1 or 2 → other method (the Live Birth Declaration manual records ultrasound as 'other method'); 9 or missing → unknown. Codes 1 and 2 also analyzed separately. Empirical evidence for code 8: code 8 first appears in 2013, when the 1,799,677 code-8 records are exactly the 1,799,677 records with a filled LMP date (DTULTMENST); in the 2015–2024 analytic sample, a valid LMP date is present in 99.998% of code-8 records and in 0% of records with codes 1, 2, or 9, and LMP-based gestational age agrees with SEMAGESTAC exactly in 79.0% and within ±1 week in 99.98%.
Use: Dating diagnostics (strata by method; dating-robust analysis = codes 1–2 excluding preterm weight >P97); Table 1

Official label (English translation): Date of last menstrual period (LMP): dd mm yyyy
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Data da última menstruação (DUM): dd mm aaaa
Codes used and recoding in this study: Valid = an existing date (ddmmyyyy) earlier than DTNASC, with an interval ≤365 days. LMP-based gestational age = floor((DTNASC − DTULTMENST)/7) completed weeks. Not used in any model.

Official label (English translation): Labor induced? 1 yes; 2 no; 3 not applicable; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Trabalho de parto induzido? Valores: 1– Sim; 2– Não; 3– Não se aplica; 9– Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Preterm births only. Provider-initiated = STTRABPART 1 OR (PARTO 2 AND STCESPARTO 1); spontaneous = not provider-initiated AND STTRABPART 2 AND (PARTO 1 OR (PARTO 2 AND STCESPARTO 2)); unclassified = all other preterm births. Provider-initiated is evaluated first; missing values meet no condition. STTRABPART 3, 9, or missing → unclassified unless cesarean with STCESPARTO 1.

Official label (English translation): Did the cesarean occur before labor started? 1 yes; 2 no; 3 not applicable; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Cesárea ocorreu antes do trabalho de parto iniciar? Valores: 1– Sim; 2– Não; 3– Não se aplica; 9– Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Used only for cesareans (PARTO 2): 1 → provider-initiated; 2 → spontaneous if STTRABPART 2; 3, 9, or missing → unclassified unless STTRABPART 1. Not used for vaginal births (missing for nearly all vaginal births in 2015; code 3 recorded from 2016).

Official label (English translation): Type of delivery: 1 vaginal; 2 cesarean; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Tipo de parto: 1– Vaginal; 2– Cesário; 9– Ignorado
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 (vaginal) and 2 (cesarean) in the classification rule (see STTRABPART); 9 or missing → unclassified unless STTRABPART 1. Table 1: mode of delivery (1, 2).

Official label (English translation): Month of gestation in which prenatal care started
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Mês de gestação em que iniciou o pré‐natal
Codes used and recoding in this study: Valid 1–9; 99, missing, and any other value excluded from numerator and denominator. Access index = % of live births with MESPRENAT 1–3 among those with valid MESPRENAT, by health region of residence × year, over all resident live births 2014–2024; each birth receives the index of year t−1; tertiles within macroregion, weighted by births (T1 = worst access). Table 1: 1–3, 4–6, 7–9 = 1st, 2nd, 3rd trimester.

Official label (English translation): Type of pregnancy: 1 single; 2 twin; 3 triplet or more; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Tipo de gravidez: 1– Única; 2– Dupla; 3– Tripla ou mais; 9– Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 → singleton; 2–3 → multiple; 9 or missing → missing. SGA, weight >P97 reclassification, and low birth weight at term restricted to GRAVIDEZ 1.

Official label (English translation): Sex: 1 M male; 2 F female; 0 I unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Sexo: 1- M – Masculino; 2- F – Feminino; 0- I – ignorado
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 → male, 2 → female (sex-specific INTERGROWTH-21st centiles); 0 or missing → not eligible for SGA or the weight >P97 criterion (not imputed).

Official label (English translation): Birth weight in grams
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Peso ao nascer em gramas.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Valid 100–7,000 g for SGA and weight plausibility. SGA = INTERGROWTH-21st weight-for-gestational-age centile <0.10 (R package gigs, value2centile, family ig_nbs, acronym wfga). Weight >P97 = centile >0.97 among singleton preterm births 24–36 weeks (reclassified as non-cases in sensitivity analyses); alternative criterion ≥2,500 g. Low birth weight at term: <2,500 g (singletons, 37–41 weeks).

Official label (English translation): Schooling, in completed years of study: 1 none; 2 1–3 years; 3 4–7 years; 4 8–11 years; 5 12 or more; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Escolaridade, em anos de estudo concluídos: 1 – Nenhuma; 2 – 1 a 3 anos; 3 – 4 a 7 anos; 4 – 8 a 11 anos; 5 – 12 e mais; 9 – Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Inclusion: 1–5 (9 or missing excluded). Model M3: five categories (reference ≥12). MAIHDA strata and race × education (exploratory): ≤7 (codes 1–3), 8–11 (4), ≥12 (5). ESCMAE2010 not used.
Use: Exclusion; covariate (M3); MAIHDA strata; imputation model

Official label (English translation): Mother's marital status: 1 single; 2 married; 3 widowed; 4 legally separated/divorced; 5 stable union; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Situação conjugal da mãe: 1– Solteira; 2– Casada; 3– Viúva; 4– Separada judicialmente/divorciada; 5– União estável; 9– Ignorada.
Codes used and recoding in this study: With partner = 2 or 5 (reference); without partner = 1, 3, or 4; 9 or missing → missing (M3 fitted in complete cases; separate 'missing' category in the imputation model).

Official label (English translation): Mother's age
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Idade da mãe
Codes used and recoding in this study: Inclusion: 10–60 years (missing, <10, >60, and code 99 excluded). Groups: <20; 20–34 (reference); ≥35.

Official label (English translation): IBGE code of the municipality of residence
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Código IBGE do município de residência
Codes used and recoding in this study: 6 digits in the data. 1st digit → macroregion (1 North, 2 Northeast, 3 Southeast, 4 South, 5 Center-West); first 2 digits → state; municipality → health region (DATASUS territorial base, December 2024; 433 regions). Codes ending in 0000 (unknown municipality; 533 births in the analytic sample) have no health region: excluded from tertile analyses, one cluster per state in the other models.
Use: Exposure unit (health region); covariate (macroregion); variance clustering; sensitivity (excluding CE and DF)

Official label (English translation): Date of birth: dd mm yyyy
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Data de nascimento: dd mm aaaa
Codes used and recoding in this study: Year of birth (= year of the file) → year (categorical covariate, reference 2015) and period (2015–2019, 2020–2021, 2022–2024); timing of the 1-year lag of the access index; LMP-based gestational age (with DTULTMENST).

Official label (English translation): Number of prenatal visits: 1 none; 2 1–3; 3 4–6; 4 7 or more; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Número de consultas de pré‐natal. Valores: 1– Nenhuma; 2– de 1 a 3; 3– de 4 a 6; 4– 7 e mais; 9– Ignorado.
Codes used and recoding in this study: Table 1: 1 → 0, 2 → 1–3, 3 → 4–6, 4 → ≥7 visits. Validity check of the access index: % with code 4 among codes 1–4, by health region × year (Spearman correlation with the index).
Use: Description (Table 1); validation of the access index

Official label (English translation): Robson group code, generated by the system
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Código do Grupo de Robson, gerado pelo sistema
Codes used and recoding in this study: Not used in the outcome definitions. Tabulated by spontaneous/provider-initiated classification and race (validation); group 11 (not documented in the data structure) counted as unknown in the missing-data table.

Official label (English translation): Type of death: 1 fetal; 2 non-fetal
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Tipo do óbito: 1-Fetal; 2-Não Fetal
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 → fetal death. Fetal death = TIPOBITO 1 AND (valid SEMAGESTAC ≥22 OR [SEMAGESTAC missing, 9, or 99 AND GESTACAO 2–6] OR PESO ≥500 g); the three criteria are combined with OR.

Official label (English translation): Number of weeks of gestation (two digits; 9 unknown)
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Nº de semanas de gestação: números com dois algarismos; 9 - ignorado
Codes used and recoding in this study: 9 and 99 treated as missing. Fetal-death criterion: ≥22. q for preterm birth = proportion <37 among fetal deaths with SEMAGESTAC 22–44; q for SGA restricted to 24–42 (INTERGROWTH-21st grid).

Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Semanas de gestação (formulário antigo): 1 - Menos de 22 semanas; 2 - 22 a 27 semanas; 3 - 28 a 31 semanas; 4 - 32 a 36 semanas; 5 - 37 a 41 semanas; 6 - 42 e + semanas
Codes used and recoding in this study: Used only when SEMAGESTAC is missing, 9, or 99: 2–6 → fetal death.

Official label (English translation): Birth weight in grams
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Peso ao nascer em gramas
Codes used and recoding in this study: ≥500 g → fetal death (OR with the gestational age criteria); 100–7,000 g required for the SGA grid (q for SGA = proportion with centile <0.10 among singleton fetal deaths 24–42 weeks with sex 1 or 2).

Official label (English translation): Sex: M,1 male; F,2 female; I,0,9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Sexo: M,1 – masculino; F,2 – feminino; I,0,9 - ignorado
Codes used and recoding in this study: M → 1, F → 2; I, 0, and 9 → missing; only 1 and 2 match the INTERGROWTH-21st grid. In 2015–2024 the field holds only codes 0, 1, and 2 (no letter codes), so the recoding does not change q for SGA.

Official label (English translation): Type of pregnancy: 1 single; 2 twin; 3 triplet or more; 9 unknown
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Tipo de gravidez: 1 – única; 2 – dupla; 3 – tripla e mais; 9 – ignorada
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1 → singleton (q for SGA).

Official label (English translation): Municipality of residence code (for fetal deaths, the mother's residence)
Official label (Portuguese, data diction: Código do município de residência. Em caso de óbito fetal, considerar o município de residência da mãe
Codes used and recoding in this study: 1st digit → macroregion, for fetal death ratios by macroregion × year (descriptive).
